_notes.states: [TT, m1, m2] - tank temp [K], branch-1 flow [kg/s], branch-2 flow [kg/s]
_notes.m0: m0 = m1 + m2 (main loop flow, Eq. 6), recovered algebraically
_notes.inputs: [m1_dot, m2_dot] - flow-rate rates of change [kg/s^2] (paper Eq. 14), rate-limited to +/- u_rate_max
_notes.outputs: Thout1, Thout2 - AHE1/AHE2 air-side outlet temperatures [K] (paper Eq. 13 controlled variables)
_notes.KA1_KA2_KA3: Identified heat-exchanger conductances from paper Table 2 (AHE1, AHE2, FHE/OHE) [W/K]
_notes.mT: Identified tank dynamic capacity, paper Section 4.1 [kg]
_notes.tau_d: Paper's identified single equivalent transport delay, Section 4.3 [s]
_notes.T_boil_limit: Water boiling point at 3 MPa pressurisation, paper Section 5.1 [K]
_notes.Thout_ref: Paper states a single 400K design target; this effectiveness-NTU model's achievable range for AHE1 (condition-1 boundary values) is ~[432,482]K and for AHE2 ~[324,490]K in the monotonic (m > crossover) operating branch, so 400K is not reachable for AHE1 with these exact KA/flow parameters. Thout1_ref/Thout2_ref are set to values centred in each exchanger's own achievable range, consistent with the paper's own generic per-channel reference framing (Eq. 13 uses Thout1*, Thout2* separately).
